How to read this

The national scenarios are modelled. The regional bars distribute those national totals under explicit constraints; they are illustrative allocations, not independently calibrated regional forecasts or a validated grid plan.

The optional capacity-derived hydro ceiling and electricity-requirement demand proxy remain exploratory pending organizer clarification.

Behind the numbers

Where the numbers come from

Audited v1.2
Data integrity

Original organizer file

635 state-year observations, 34 states/UTs, 2006–2024. It lacks generated electricity, so CEA/MoP generation was added as a separate source. The organizer CSV remains unchanged.

SHA-256 f8f98adfc00457f3cd6033193722503fc481250d19ec37e0c692b35450d7bd4f
Validation

National statistical model

Random walk with drift was selected among four candidate interval models. CEA financial-year backtests at horizons 1–5 produced 5.37% WAPE (40 predictions); Ember calendar-year backtests produced 4.25% WAPE (70 predictions).

The 2047 statistical interval extrapolates beyond tested horizons; it is not calibrated at 21 years.

Accounting and guardrails

Regional solver

All 66 default region-year allocations solved and conserved national domestic generation. A 20% hydro stress case requires about 1,062 TWh against an indicative 480 TWh ceiling and is correctly flagged infeasible. This ceiling uses a capacity ratio and remains exploratory.

Known limits

What remains open

185 of 186 source checks pass; PSAG-GR-2011 is a documented source inconsistency. Regional predictive backtesting, resource siting, dispatch adequacy, storage and network feasibility have not been demonstrated.

DefinitionsObserved: CEA/MoP and organizer records. Estimated: historic fuel split/import gaps. Modelled: national scenarios. Assumed: 2047 mix, economic and demographic paths. Exploratory: regional allocation, demand proxy and hydro ceiling.
